ollama.prompt: Scrivi un testo lungo e dettagliato sul mare, almeno duecento parole.

association.request_window: half-open [t_send_mono_ns, t_end_mono_ns); t_send is taken immediately before the HTTP request, t_end after the last NDJSON line
association.telemetry_sample_membership: a telemetry sample belongs to a window iff t_send_mono_ns <= monotonic_ns < t_end_mono_ns
association.telemetry_cpu_semantics: CPU percentages cover the interval ending at the sample's monotonic_ns; RSS is instantaneous. Both are diagnostics, not energy.
association.emi_increment_membership: an EMI increment [t_i, t_{i+1}) belongs to a window iff t_send <= t_i and t_{i+1} <= t_end; increments that straddle a boundary are excluded and counted
association.emi_timestamp_offset: if the energy side uses the EMI ts_100ns clock, its offset to time.monotonic_ns must be measured on paired reads and declared; it is never assumed constant or zero
association.wall_clock_role: utc_minus_mono_ms detects wall-clock steps; the production timestamp_start/end have one-second resolution (benchmark_unified.py:810) and cannot define a window of a few seconds by themselves
association.same_boot_session: monotonic timestamps are comparable across processes only within the same boot session
association.no_interpolation_here: this harness records windows and coverage; it does not interpolate counters or compute energy
